questions.stem: Dr. Anjali is conducting a research project on the role of societal factors in health outcomes. She discusses with her mentor about the origin of medical sociology to better understand its evolution. Her mentor asks her if she knows who first proposed the concept of medical sociology. Who is credited with first proposing the concept of medical sociology?
